result.body:
## Bug (caught live)

`GhCli.merged_pr_merge_shas` — the GitHub provenance source added in #196 —
requested `gh pr list --json mergeCommitOid`. That flat field exists on
`gh pr view` but **not** on `gh pr list`, which exposes the merge commit as a
nested `mergeCommit` object. `gh` rejected it ("Unknown JSON field:
mergeCommitOid"), the method returned an empty set, and
`repoach release gate --provenance github` **fail-closed** on a sound release
range — caught while dogfooding the path on release PR #199 (the gate refused
rather than falsely approving, which is the right failure direction).

The unit tests missed it because the recording fake faked `_run` (never ran real
`gh`) and the integration test overrode the whole method — no test crossed the
real `gh pr list` field boundary.

## Fix

- Request `--json mergeCommit` and read `mergeCommit.oid`.
- **Verified live**: `merged_pr_merge_shas` now returns 187 SHAs (was 0),
  including #196's own merge commit.

## Regression guards

- The recording fake now mirrors the real nested `{"mergeCommit": {"oid": ...}}`
  shape, so the parsing test validates against the actual gh output.
- A new test pins the argv: `--json` must request `mergeCommit`, never the
  `gh pr view` flat field.
result.title: fix(release): gh pr list exposes mergeCommit, not mergeCommitOid
